notes.title: The Demo is Out Now! - STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.content:
Dear Comrades, This is Kei, the developer.

Today, I have released the demo and joined the Steam Next Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191525/715cba213964412d90630594cc9c642f1cd2becd.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3404700/_Demo/

[h3]About the demo version[/h3]
[list]
[*] 30 minutes of gameplay.
[*] Two stages, including the introductory story stage.
[/list]
This demo is available only during the Steam Next Fest period until March 3, 2025.

Join the struggle against the evil capitalists for the glory of our motherland!

Long live the great Varnakia!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191525/e3de661535f4159286e832805fe37bf1d245e17c.png[/img]

notes.title: Playable at Tokyo Game Show 2024!
notes.content:
Greetings, comrades! Thank you for your continued support.
This is Kei, the developer.

We are excited to announce that "Absolute Rocket Defense Ideology" will be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2024, which will take place from September 26th to September 29th at Makuhari Messe!

At our booth, you'll have the chance to play the latest version of the demo.

In the demo, you can experience one stage of the game. Be sure to defeat the capitalists, strengthen your base, indoctrinate your soldiers with revolutionary ideals, and launch your ideological satellite into space!

Long live the great motherland!

[h3]《 Tokyo Game Show Exhibition Details 》[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Venue:[/b] Makuhari Messe (Chiba, Japan)
[*] [b]Dates:[/b] Thursday, September 26, 2024 – Sunday, September 29, 2024

[/list]
